registrationProvenance: Reviewer printed-grid fit, independently visually read back against N110/120/130 at both map borders; about 1–4 source pixels discrepancy, not survey control.
limitations: North-sheet grid fit; south-sheet offset about four pixels in reviewer check. Town symbols differ about 150–300m; ink about 100–200m wide. About 0.5km discrimination, not a survey. All 38 >300m JS cluster worst-point crops inspected; most cannot resolve a whole cluster.
